content: Alan Jenner, outdoor and adventure sports development officer for GSC, said: "It's a vital part of learning for children, because we live on an island, they've got to understand about water safety and they've got to understand about the Guernsey environment."

Andy Roberts: I know there has been in excess of 100 drownings in the past 10 years by people attempting this crossing. I cannot believe that there has been only one incident with in excess of 20 people drowning.
